title: Restrict service principal OAuth secrets to specific API scopes
body: You can now restrict a service principal's OAuth secret to specific API scopes, such as `sql` or `jobs`, instead of all APIs. A token minted from a scoped secret can't exceed those scopes, which limits the impact of a leaked secret. See [Authorize service principal access to Databricks with OAuth](/aws/en/dev-tools/auth/oauth-m2m).
